paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The line plot titled "Prompt Depth vs Accuracy" illustrates the relationship between prompt depth and accuracy (%) for two models, mmsd and mmsd2, across a range of prompt depths from 1 to 11. The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Depth (J)", is a linear scale with integer values ranging from 1 to 11. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", is also a linear scale ranging from 74 to 81. The data for the mmsd model, represented by an orange dashed line with square markers, shows a relatively stable accuracy around 80% for prompt depths from 1 to 7, with a slight increase to a peak of 81.2% at a prompt depth of 9, followed by a decrease to 80.1% at a depth of 11. The mmsd2 model, represented by a blue solid line with circular markers, exhibits a different trend: its accuracy starts at 76.5% at a prompt depth of 1, decreases to a minimum of 74.0% at a depth of 3, then increases to a peak of 77.5% at a depth of 9, and finally decreases to 76.7% at a depth of 11.
